title: Molly and the Wheel That Wobbled
synopsis: Molly hears the new wagon clunk and Ms. Pam finds a loose wheel fitting; the adults correct it and test the wagon on smooth pavement and gravel.
continuity_state: Before: Mr. Lee and Ms. Pam have begun the red wagon for Jack. It has four intended wheels and is not a ride-on vehicle. Gus has the big cardboard box and blue ribbon. Jack does not know about the gift. After: Ms. Pam corrects the fourth wheel fitting; the adult makers inspect and test the cart. All four wheels roll properly, the paint is drying, and the wagon is hidden safely at the garage for Saturday.
